name: Shehbaz Sharif
ideology: Centre-right, infrastructure development, private sector growth, pragmatic foreign diplomacy
period_active: Prime Minister since March 2024 (previously PM April 2022 - August 2023)
foreign_policy_position: Champion of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC); deepening strategic ties with Beijing while actively resetting relations with Washington; securing sovereign investment and deposits from Saudi Arabia and UAE; advocating peaceful bilateral resolution of the Jammu & Kashmir dispute.
current_status: In office, heading a multi-party coalition government focused on IMF macro-stabilization, inflation reduction, and privatization.
